description: Abstract class for managing MQTT gateway device session context, handling device attributes, RPC requests, and session lifecycle events within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AbstractGatewayDeviceSessionContext
classes.description: Abstract class managing MQTT gateway device session state, including attribute responses, RPC requests, and session lifecycle events.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the current session.

methods.name: nextMsgId
methods.description: Retrieves the next message ID from the parent session handler.

methods.name: onGetAttributesResponse
methods.description: Handles responses for device attribute requests, converting and forwarding them as MQTT messages.

methods.name: onAttributeUpdate
methods.description: Processes attribute update notifications and forwards them as MQTT messages.

methods.name: onToDeviceRpcRequest
methods.description: Handles RPC requests to the device, converting and sending them via MQTT, and processing delivery status.

methods.name: onRemoteSessionCloseCommand
methods.description: Handles remote commands to close the session and deregisters the session.

methods.name: onToServerRpcResponse
methods.description: Placeholder for handling server RPC responses; not supported in current implementation.

methods.name: onDeviceDeleted
methods.description: Handles device deletion events, notifying parent to update session state.

methods.name: isAckExpected
methods.description: Determines if an MQTT message expects an acknowledgment based on QoS level.
